title: How many sorted projections determine n points in k dimensions?
abstract: arXiv:2611.06470v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Let $d_1,\dots,d_m$ be directions in $\mathbb{R}^k$, where $k\ge 2$. A multiset $X$ of $n$ points of $\mathbb{R}^k$ projects to the $m$ multisets of numbers $\{\{x\cdot d_j : x\in X\}\}$, or equivalently to the $m$ sorted lists of these numbers. How many directions are needed for these projections to determine every multiset of $n$ points? Two simple bounds are known in every dimension: more than $(k-1)\log_2 n$ directions are always needed, and $(k-1)n+1$ directions in general position always suffice. In the plane much more is known: Matousek, Privetivy and Skovron showed that almost every choice of $O(\log n \log\log n)$ directions suffices. Whether anything similar holds in higher dimensions was left open by Dym, Wellershoff, Tsoukanis, Levy and Balan. translated_title: 多少个有序投影能确定k维空间中的n个点？
translated_abstract: 设 $d_1,\dots,d_m$ 为 $\mathbb{R}^k$ 中的方向，其中 $k\ge 2$。$\mathbb{R}^k$ 中 $n$ 个点构成的多重集 $X$ 会投影为 $m$ 个数字多重集 $\{\{x\cdot d_j : x\in X\}\}$，或等价地，投影为这些数字的 $m$ 个排序列表。需要多少个方向才能使这些投影确定任意一个由 $n$ 个点构成的多重集？在每个维度上都有两个已知的简单界：总是需要多于 $(k-1)\log_2 n$ 个方向，而处于一般位置的 $(k-1)n+1$ 个方向总是足够的。在平面上，人们知道得更多：Matousek、Privetivy 和 Skovron 证明了几乎任何 $O(\log n \log\log n)$ 个方向的选择都足够。至于在高维空间中是否有类似的结果成立，这是 Dym、Wellershoff、Tsoukanis、Levy 和 Balan 留下的开放问题。我们观察到，Hair 和 Sahai 为随机线性码的列表恢复所证明的两个引理可以回答该问题，并且通过收紧他们的论证，我们证明了在每个维度中……
tldr: 本文借助Hair和Sahai关于随机线性码列表恢复的两个引理，证明了在任意k维空间中，几乎任意选择适当数量的方向即可确定n个点的多重集，从而回答了Dym等人提出的高维开放问题。
en_tdlr: By applying two lemmas of Hair and Sahai on list recovery of random linear codes, this paper shows that in every dimension, almost every choice of a suitable number of directions suffices to determine any multiset of n points, resolving an open question posed by Dym et al.
